quote: Recital C of the Amendment states that Supplier issued a Price Adjustment Notice on July 30, 2026, for a 14% increase effective October 2, 2026. Customer received it on August 3, 2026. The 30-day objection period under § 5.4 expired on **September 2, 2026**. The Amendment is dated September 21, 2026, and confirms that "No objection to the Price Adjustment Notice has been delivered by Customer." Under § 5.4, the increase is now "deemed accepted by Customer..."
reason: The memo cites Recital C, gives the August 3, 2026 receipt date, and ties it to Supply Agreement § 5.4. It states the 30-day window expired September 2, 2026, before the September 21, 2026 amendment, so the 14% increase is deemed accepted. It also says no mechanism allows a later challenge. That is consistent with no extension or waiver existing, though the memo does not suggest negotiating one.
